name: Raj Packaging Industries Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1987, Raj Packaging Industries 
Ltd manufactures multilayer co-extruded plastic 
film and flexible packaging material[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:[1]
a) Multilayer films: These are used in packaging industry due to convenience and better shelf life
b) Laminates: Company offers High impact multilayer printed/unprinted Laminates for all purpose
c) Shrink Films: Company provides shrink wrap films and pouches for food and non-food industries

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.23% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -6.41% over last 3 years.
